text:
Maya R: Flagging a customer billing mismatch. Vendor invoice shows 1,200 GPU-hours for acme-prod on 2026-03-20 but our internal allocation split 1,200 -> 300 to research-infra and 900 to acme-corp. Customer says it should be 1,200 on their account.

Omar V: Likely ETL owner_team drop for some cloud lines. Can you share sample raw line?

Maya R: Sample: `vendor_line_id=VL-9987 vendor_project=acme-prod cloud_tags={customer_id:acme-corp, owner_team:null}`. Our fallback logic currently assigns NULL owner_team lines to a heuristic bucket (research-infra).

billing-bot: automated-alert: external_invoice_mismatch > 500 gpu_hours for acme-corp 2026-03-20

Chen L: Quick fix proposal: run backfill to reassign allocations to cloud_tags.customer_id when owner_team IS NULL for the invoice date. Script small SQL patch: `UPDATE billing.alloc SET customer_id='acme-corp' WHERE vendor_line='VL-9987' AND owner_team IS NULL;` Run as dry-run then apply.

AcmeBilling: We can reissue credits if you provide corrected allocation CSV and invoice IDs.

Maya R: I've simulated the backfill on a snapshot: moves 912 GPU-hours back to acme-corp and removes the spike on research-infra. PR with sim attached: https://git.internal/redwood/billing/pull/5022

Omar V: Platform please validate backfill dry-run; finance needs provisional ledger reclassification approval.

Chen L: I'll coordinate canary in prod tonight 02:00 UTC, run dry-run and post logs.

Maya R: Finance approves provisional reclassification pending: 1) PR merged, 2) dry-run logs show no conflicts, 3) vendor confirmation. I'll notify Acme support and cc finance-ops.

billing-bot: ticket ACCT-5621 created for ledger adjustment

Maya R: Thanks all — will close once vendor issues credit and backfill completes.
